remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained, custom-built Barden home, lovingly cared for by just two owners! Situated on a desirable corner lot in the scenic Indian Falls Lake HOA, this property offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and recreation. Enjoy all the perks of lake living, including fishing, canoeing, rowboating, or simply relaxing on the beach, just a short walk from the house! Inside, you'll appreciate the centrally located first-floor laundry, cozy gas fireplace, and reverse osmosis drinking water system. Step outside and unwind by the outdoor wood burnign fireplace, perfect for entertaining or enjoying peaceful evenings. Additional highlights include a blacktop driveway sealed annually, a tankless on-demand water heater (just 2 years old), and a new generator to keep the essentials running during those unpredictable WNY storms! The partially finished basement offers additional recreational space, with the pool table and workout equipment included in the sale. Pride of ownership shines throughout this exceptional home. Don't miss your opportunity to enjoy the Indian Falls Lake lifestyle! Showings begin Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at 9 AM. Offers will be reviewed Monday, October 19, 2026, at 6 PM.
